name: OpenPI pi05 LIBERO fixed-protocol reproduction and sensitivity study
scope: Fixed-base manipulation in one physics environment; no navigation, no physical robot, no claim of own pretrained weights

environment.image_rotation: 180 degrees for both views, matching upstream

baseline.note: 3 initial states per task is a small reproduction, not the official 50-per-task protocol

paired_interventions.note: Task subset fixed before observing performance. Wrong-language success is scored against original task, not obedience to replacement instruction.

intervention_details.blank_images: zero both RGB images; state and language unchanged
intervention_details.frozen_images: repeat initial post-settling images; current state and language unchanged
intervention_details.wrong_language: replace with task_id+1 modulo 10 instruction in same suite
intervention_details.state_noise: Gaussian 5mm on measured xyz only, independent per policy query; no true state or object modification
intervention_details.action_delay: queue of 2 control actions, 100ms simulated delay; FIFO and initial no-op; no wall-clock delay
intervention_details.replan_10: Execute 10 predicted actions per query instead of 5; same model and simulator
intervention_details.denoising_5: Use 5 flow-matching integration steps instead of 10; same weights, explicit noise and replan interval

success: official environment task predicate after applying action; timeout is failure; exceptions recorded separately
records: per-query full predicted chunks and input metadata
analysis: prediction and end-to-end wall times separately
goal satisfaction versus response to language
selected failure videos; no synthetic outcomes
training: First reproduce official checkpoint and evaluate interfaces. Any later adaptation requires separate train/validation/test data and is not inferred from this reproduction.
